title: Second Life Repair Campaign
lead: Make repair feel like a first choice. Show the work, explain the process and make booking simple.
label: illustrative repair slots over four weeks
intro: A fictional campaign for a local repair collective. The offer covers a 20-minute assessment; repair price and turnaround are confirmed after inspection.
sections: Lead with a well-used object and its repair, not an unsupported sustainability promise. Explain what can be fixed and what cannot.
Book an assessment, bring the item and receive a written estimate. No repair begins without approval. Parts may affect timing.
Track assessment bookings, attended appointments and approved repairs separately. Do not present bookings as completed repairs.
closing: Fictional campaign · Capacity figures are planning assumptions.
prompt: Use Dazzler to create a fictional marketing document and web edition for this task: Make repair feel like a first choice. Show the work, explain the process and make booking simple. Retain every supplied fact and qualification. An oversized campaign statement leads into a narrow numbered channel register and an indented offer story. Use Oswald for the web and verified Arial for native output, with #1551A4 against #FFFFFF. Author a distinct composition rather than recoloring the previous release. Keep native text and tables editable and verify narrow layouts.
colorDirection: Hot-pink repair campaign with a cobalt evidence band and black typography.
